text: Mayday, mayday, mayday. Wuhan approach. Air Canada 503. Fire detected in rear cabin. Dense smoke has spread all over. Request emergency assistance. We are maintaining 3,900 metres on heading 040 degrees. Request return to land. Air Canada 503. Roger, mayday. Turn left, heading 210. I will veck you to final of runway 04. Question. Where is the fire?
